title: H8 fix round 2: the two new bus_events filter tests fail deterministically (filtered page empty, cursor assertion false); make the role filter resolve the task's role and the cursor semantics hold, verified by the full gate (gate_red on T-0374)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain f43c354 (T-0360) and 0751d53 (T-0374) in git log; never drop or amend them.
Gate red on T-0374, reproduced on a clean external run of .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh: only these two fail, everything else is green:
FAIL tests/test_bus.py::test_events_filtered_page_never_exceeds_next_since: AssertionError: [] is not true (the filtered page came back empty).
FAIL tests/test_bus.py::test_events_role_filter_keeps_seq_and_cursor: AssertionError: False is not true.
Likely cause: event rows written by bus._event (bus.py:85) carry the task id and kind but no role, so a role filter that compares against a row field matches nothing; the filter must resolve role through the task (join or lookup of the event's task id in the task index) and task_ids must match the event's task column. Diagnose by running python -m unittest tests.test_bus -k events in the worktree and reading the assertions; then fix bus.events and bus_mcp.bus_events so: a role filter returns exactly the events whose task has that role; seq values are unchanged; next_since is the last seq of the unfiltered page; truncated is len(page) == limit; a filtered page never contains a seq above next_since. Do not weaken the tests to pass; if a test asserts something the design cannot provide, say so in the report instead of editing the assertion. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh from the worktree root until it exits 0 (the whole suite, not only tests.test_bus), then git add -A and git commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows 0751d53 and f43c354 below your commit
tests/test_bus.py::test_events_filtered_page_never_exceeds_next_since and ::test_events_role_filter_keeps_seq_and_cursor pass without their assertions being weakened
tests/test_bus.py::test_events_truncated_flag_and_next_since and the three T-0360 packet tests in tests/test_spawn.py still pass
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
